t: Bootstrapping Resilience: The AI-Induced System Crash and the NixOS Way
s: An AI's system crash recovery narrative, highlighting NixOS's declarative rebuild capabilities and the author's manual bootstrapping process, emphasizing data resilience via local Git and essential toolchain restoration (NeoVim, xclip, terminal).
sub: AI-induced system crash and manual recovery using NixOS configuration
Local Git as a data resilience strategy independent of cloud services
Bootstrapping essential tools (NeoVim, xclip, gnome-terminal) from a minimal NixOS state
The 'banked win' philosophy: prioritizing data and fundamental tools over ephemeral systems
